races.paceDynamic: Lord Capulet is the only confirmed front runner in this field and will dictate terms from the outset without pressure. His sustainable pace-setting style, combined with recent wins at this 7f trip, means he can control the gallop and kick clear when ready. The large field of hold-up horses including Spirit Genie, King's School, and Calyxoh will be bunched behind him, creating a wall of traffic in the straight. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can track Lord Capulet and front runners who can steal a march before the hold-up brigade get organized.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lord Capulet Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Capulet gets an uncontested lead and quickens at the right moment
scenarios.body: He can use his tactical advantage to kick clear before the hold-up horses get into gear. The combination of his recent winning form and race-reading ability makes him hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the large pack of hold-up horses create interference problems in the straight
scenarios.body: The best of the hold-up merchants who get a clear run will prevail, likely those drawn better or with stronger jockeys. King's School and Spirit Genie have the class to overcome minor trouble.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Capulet goes too fast early or ties up in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the freshest hold-up horse with the best turn of foot wins. Recent winner King's School has shown he can quicken well off this pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites are caught up in traffic or underperform
scenarios.body: A well-positioned outsider like Mission Command or Paws For Thought could sneak through for connections hitting form. Both have tactical speed to avoid trouble.

watchPoints.text: Lord Capulet must be watched closely for market support as the only pace angle in a race full of hold-up horses
Spirit Genie and King's School are the pick of the hold-up horses but need clean passages through traffic
Mission Command represents the in-form Candlish stable and gets weight relief from 5lb claiming rider
Calyxoh faces a big ask returning from 98-day break under inexperienced amateur in competitive handicap
The soft going report shows consistent conditions across the card which should suit proven soft ground performers

races.paceDynamic: Silver State will take the field along from the front with minimal pressure, given the lack of other committed pace-setters in this field. The majority of runners (Colourband, Mr Seagull, Simon Pierre, Morbeh) hold prominent positions but none are natural pace-pressers, allowing Silver State to dictate terms. With hold-up horses like Valpovo, Magic Trip, and Home Hero sitting well back, this creates a clear tactical split. This sustainable pace scenario heavily favours the prominent runners who can track Silver State without expending energy, then strike in the straight when the hold-up horses have too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Silver State maintains an even gallop without serious pace pressure from the prominent group
scenarios.body: The front division gets first run while hold-up horses struggle to close from too far back on testing ground. Prominent runners who tracked the pace get ideal positioning to strike.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too sedate and the field bunches entering the straight
scenarios.body: Superior class tells as the race opens up late, allowing the better-rated hold-up horses to unleash finishing kicks. The soft ground aids their stamina reserves.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Silver State stops quickly having done too much early work under pressure
scenarios.body: The race falls apart completely with no sustainable pace foundation established. This creates a messy sprint finish where anything positioned handily can capitalize.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners pressure Silver State from the outset creating genuine pace
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop stretches the field but ultimately favours the most robust stayers. Only horses with proven stamina reserves can sustain the effort.

races.paceDynamic: Cool Molly looks the most likely pace-setter with her prominent style and consistent front-running ability, though several other prominent runners like Runswick, Vidmiyr and Crazee Icon could press forward early. With multiple prominent types but no confirmed tearaway leader, expect a solid but not overly strong gallop through the middle stages. The hold-up horses like Dartrey, Norman Invasion and Jackabi will rely on the pace being strong enough to set up their finishing kicks. This pace shape slightly favours the prominent racers who can get into good positions without being pressured, rather than the hold-up horses who need a stronger tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Cool Molly, Runswick and Vidmiyr dictate a steady tempo without killing each other off early.
scenarios.body: The pace allows the front division to stay strong late while hold-up horses find insufficient pace collapse to fuel their finishing kicks. Those positioned handy throughout hold decisive advantages in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses go faster than expected or engage in early tactical battles.
scenarios.body: A stronger pace sets up perfect conditions for the closers to unleash late runs with Dartrey and Norman Invasion benefiting from their class. The early pace merchants weaken in the final furlong as fresher horses come through.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys are overly cautious early and create a pedestrian gallop through halfway.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the three-furlong pole favouring horses with natural speed regardless of style. Raw ability trumps tactics as the field bunches up entering the straight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to handle the softer conditions or encounter trouble in running.
scenarios.body: The race opens up for horses lower in the betting who are better suited to the ground or benefit from a cleaner passage. Form figures become less reliable than tactical positioning and going preferences.

watchPoints.text: Cool Molly's early positioning will be crucial - if she breaks slowly or gets shuffled back, her prominent style becomes compromised.
Dartrey needs to settle kindly early given his hold-up style, any keen racing early will blunt his finishing kick.
The pace through the first three furlongs - if too slow it negates the hold-up horses' chances completely.
Norman Invasion's handling of the softer ground on just his second run on going easier than good.
How aggressively the prominent horses engage early will determine whether this becomes a tactical affair or genuine test.

races.paceDynamic: Abundant will take the field along as the sole confirmed front-runner, with Miss Lady Grace the only other prominent runner likely to press early. The small field and lack of early speed will create a sustainable tempo through the middle furlongs on this testing ground. With seven hold-up horses having to overcome a modest gallop, this sets up perfectly for those who can travel and deliver their challenge late. The race shape strongly favours closers who can quicken off the sedate pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Dominate Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains genuinely steady throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early burn allows hold-up horses to conserve energy and deliver stronger finishing kicks on the soft ground. Quality closers with proven acceleration like Gizmo and The Resdev Scholar can exploit the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Abundant and Miss Lady Grace work together early
scenarios.body: They establish a workable lead without pressure, controlling fractions and making it difficult for the large group of hold-up horses to peg them back. Recent winner Miss Lady Grace particularly benefits from dictating terms.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If the tempo becomes genuinely crawling
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where class and current form matter more than running style. This opens the door for any horse carrying momentum into the final furlong regardless of early position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Abundant Breaks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If the leader gets an uncontested lead of 4+ lengths
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses leave themselves too much to do on the testing surface and Abundant's early advantage proves decisive. This requires Miss Lady Grace to settle rather than press.

races.paceDynamic: Model Yuko will be the sole genuine front-runner with several prominent racers (Quebella, Patagonia Girl, Lady Ridgewood, Star Cast, Tryst) tracking closely behind in the early stages. This creates a solid but not punishing gallop over Chester's unique round mile, with the hold-up pair Princess Rascal and Winged One needing to navigate traffic around the tight turns. The pace setup should be honest but sustainable, creating a fair test that allows prominent racers to travel well before the climb to the line. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can position handy and have something left for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays honest and sustainable as expected
scenarios.body: Model Yuko sets manageable fractions allowing the prominent pack to travel well and kick clear up Chester's demanding finish. The hold-up horses struggle to make ground around the tight turns and up the hill.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack go too hard trying to collar Model Yuko early
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable by halfway, setting up perfect conditions for Princess Rascal and Winged One to sweep past tired leaders. Both hold-up runners get clear runs when it matters most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Model Yuko gets uncontested early fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The vanguard leader builds an unassailable advantage before the prominent pack can respond, staying on strongly up Chester's climb. The chasers are left playing for minor honours.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses into a sprint and traffic causes chaos in the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure stamina test up the hill where one of the hold-up runners finds clear daylight and outstays the field. Positioning and luck become decisive factors.

Quebella's consistency with Jamie Spencer aboard making her dangerous if getting good position throughout
Track conditions holding up through the card as repeated going reports suggest surface may be riding differently than official

races.paceDynamic: Dolos Dream and Tactical Blitz will likely contest the early lead, with Dolos Dream's prominent style and recent front-running success making him the probable pacesetter. The moderate pace will allow the large hold-up contingent of Start Me Up, Trust Amy, Nebulon, Saucy Jane, Explosive Finnish and Try Storm Cat to stay within striking distance. With six horses committed to waiting tactics in a small eight-runner field, the pace will be honest but not destructive. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can secure good positions early, as the hold-up horses will face a traffic-heavy finish with limited opportunities.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Dolos Dream and Tactical Blitz control the pace without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The front pair maintain their advantage as the large hold-up brigade struggles for racing room in the final furlong. Dolos Dream's recent front-running form and Tactical Blitz's proven 6f ability see them dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuine enough to set up the hold-up horses
scenarios.body: The waiting tactics of Start Me Up, Nebulon and Explosive Finnish pay dividends as they find clear runs to overhaul tiring leaders. Start Me Up's class and Nebulon's consistent placings prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the large hold-up contingent creates significant interference in the straight
scenarios.body: Multiple horses get blocked as six runners come from behind simultaneously, allowing one prominent runner to steal away. The cleaner journey proves more valuable than raw ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If Try Storm Cat finds significant improvement stepping back to 6f
scenarios.body: The longest-priced runner benefits from the pace setup and Cieren Fallon's big-race experience to outrun odds. His previous 8f placings suggest stamina isn't an issue when the pace is right.

Watch for pace collapse if both Dolos Dream and Tactical Blitz go too fast early in small field

races.paceDynamic: Oman leads the prominent contingent alongside Coolree, Military Leader, Dapper Gee Gee and Mariner, creating a solid early gallop over Chester's tight 7½f trip. The substantial hold-up brigade featuring Red Mirage, Pension Pot, Nordic Norm, Chilly Breeze, Not Me and Born A Rebel will need to navigate traffic on Chester's unique bowl configuration. With multiple prominent runners ensuring a true pace and Chester's track characteristics demanding tactical positioning, this race strongly favours horses that can secure early position and travel smoothly rather than those relying on late swoops from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group maintains strong gallop without collapsing
scenarios.body: Chester's tight turns and short straight reward horses travelling in touch throughout, making late challenges from the rear extremely difficult. The pace-setters kick clear in the final two furlongs with hold-up horses struggling for room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If early pace is strong but prominent runners tire approaching final furlong
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop sets up perfectly for one closer who gets the right split at the crucial moment. Red Mirage or Born A Rebel capitalise on their finishing kick when others weaken.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If pace becomes moderate allowing more horses to stay in contention
scenarios.body: Multiple runners remain with chances turning for home creating a cavalry charge finish. Chester's unique straight becomes a dash with several runners having legitimate winning chances.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If favourite runners fail to handle Chester's demands or going conditions
scenarios.body: Track specialists or improving handicappers exploit others' tactical errors or ground concerns. Less fancied runners who suit the specific conditions outrun their odds.
